text:
maria_cs: Hey team — AcmeCorp says their Q4 enterprise credit wasn't applied to invoice INV-2024-1147. Sales left a PO note but billing shows full charge. Can someone check ingestion?

jamie_cs: Which invoice number and contract id?

maria_cs: INV-2024-1147, contract C-ACME-0098. Sales uploaded PO 987654 to SF under the opportunity but I don't see the attachment in the billing portal. Customer provided screenshot.

ravi_sales: I added a note in Salesforce: 'Apply PROMO-ENT-2024 (10k) per contract; PO 987654 attached.' I uploaded the PO file there — might not have been picked up by our billing ingestion job.

tony_support: Running quick check against billing DB now.

tony_support: Query: ```sql
SELECT invoice_number, amount_due, credits_applied, attachment_count FROM billing.invoices WHERE invoice_number='INV-2024-1147';
```

tony_support: Result: invoice_number=INV-2024-1147, amount_due=54200, credits_applied=0, attachment_count=0. No credit lines present.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BL-4321 — "Missing enterprise credit on INV-2024-1147" assigned to finance-ops.

oliver_finance: Thanks. Looks like the attachment ingestion didn't link the PO to the invoice, so automated credit didn't trigger. We can do a manual adjustment but need sales approval and a memo on file. Ravi — can you confirm PROMO ID and sales approval?

ravi_sales: Promo is PROMO-ENT-2024, approved by sasha_revenue on 2024-11-02 in the contract amendment. Sasha confirmed verbally earlier today. You have approval to proceed. :thumbsup:

jamie_cs: Ok — I'll prepare a manual credit entry. Plan: 1) create ledger adjustment 2) add memo referencing PO 987654 and contract C-ACME-0098 3) upload PO to billing portal and update SF opportunity 4) notify customer with credit confirmation.

jamie_cs: Run this internal command to apply (finance tooling):
```
ledger-cli adjust --invoice INV-2024-1147 --amount -10000 --promo PROMO-ENT-2024 --memo "Manual credit applied per PO 987654 / C-ACME-0098"
```

oliver_finance: After you run it, reply here with the adjustment id and I'll reconcile the GL entry. Also please attach the scanned PO to billing record and update the SF opportunity link so we have an audit trail.

jamie_cs: Adjustment done. ID ADJ-2024-887. Updated billing portal: attachment count now 1. SF opportunity updated with file link.

tony_support: Re-running invoice lookup now — credits_applied=10000, amount_due=44200. Looks good.

maria_cs: Customer notified with confirmation email and copy of the updated invoice. They replied "thanks", asking for a short confirmation note for their AP team.

ravi_sales: Thanks everyone — please add a short memo to the customer email: "Credit applied per PO 987654 as agreed under contract C-ACME-0098."

jamie_cs: Sent final email with memo and attached adjusted invoice. Marking BL-4321 resolved.

billing-bot: BL-4321 status changed to Resolved by jamie_cs.

oliver_finance: I'll close the GL reconciliation next week and move the journal to closed. Leave the ticket if anything else pops up.

maria_cs: Closing loop with customer; they confirmed receipt and balanced in their ledger. All good.

ravi_sales: Great — thanks for the quick turnaround team :party_popper:
